sentences.text: 外部性概念最早由 Alfred Marshall 在1890年代提出。
sentences.evidence: The concept of externality was first developed by Alfred Marshall in the 1890s

sentences.text: 由于资源可以得到更好配置，外部性是市场失灵的一个例子。
sentences.evidence: Thus, since resources can be better allocated, externalities are an example of market failure.

sentences.text: 由于监管者并不总能掌握外部性的全部信息，征收恰当的税可能很困难。
sentences.evidence: since regulators do not always have all the information on the externality, it can be difficult to impose the right tax
